name: app-oviah-research-stats-summary-cards-with-hero-phone
title: OVIAH research summary: four bold stat cards (82 responses, 07 interviews, 04 competitors, 01 opportunity) beside a phone's onboarding buttons
whatItIs: A 2x2 grid of lilac cards with huge numerals and labels ('82 Survey Responses', '07 User Interviews', '04 Competitors Studied', '01 Design Opportunity'), beside a cropped phone screen showing 'Get Started' and 'I Already have an Account' buttons.
whatItMeans: Confident and concise; distilling a whole research phase into four big numbers makes rigour easy to skim.
techniques: Summarise a research phase as four headline numbers.
Use consistent card sizing so numbers, not cards, draw focus.
Pair a research recap with a glimpse of where it led.

vocabulary.definition: A card highlighting one number as its focal point.
A condensed summary of a research phase's scope.
